title: Start with a Seedance 2.0 video, then use Omni to reimagine the same footage by…
content: Start with a Seedance 2.0 video, then use Omni to reimagine the same footage by prompting different transformations (e.g., The Backrooms style or “show Polaroids on a table as the footage progresses”).
tips: Start with a Seedance 2.0 video, then use Omni to reimagine the same footage by prompting different transformations (e.g., The Backrooms style or “show Polaroids on a table as the footage progresses”).

es.content: Comienza con un video de Seedance 2.0, luego utiliza Omni para reinventar el mismo metraje solicitando diferentes transformaciones (por ejemplo, estilo The Backrooms o “mostrar Polaroids en una mesa a medida que avanza el metraje”).

fr.content: Commencez avec une vidéo Seedance 2.0, puis utilisez Omni pour réimaginer les mêmes séquences en proposant différentes transformations (par exemple, style The Backrooms ou « montrer des Polaroids sur une table au fur et à mesure que la séquence progresse »).

ja.content:
---
Seedance 2.0のビデオから始めて、Omniを使用して異なる変換を促すことで同じ映像を再構築します（例：The Backroomsスタイルや「映像が進むにつれてテーブルにポラロイド写真を見せる」）。

ko.content: Seedance 2.0 비디오로 시작한 후, Omni를 사용하여 동일한 영상을 다양한 변환을 통해 재구성하세요 (예: The Backrooms 스타일 또는 "영상이 진행됨에 따라 테이블 위에 폴라로이드 사진을 보여주기").

pt.content: Comece com um vídeo Seedance 2.0, depois use o Omni para reimaginar a mesma filmagem, solicitando diferentes transformações (por exemplo, The Backrooms style ou “show Polaroids on a table as the footage progresses”).

zh.content: 从Seedance 2.0视频开始，然后使用Omni通过提示不同的转换来重新构想相同的镜头（例如，The Backrooms风格或“随着镜头的推进，在桌子上展示拍立得照片”）。
